channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from FMallSectionsDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Could an 'invasion' declaration reverse the Supreme Court's birthright citizenship ruling?
item.description: Indiana Republican Sen. Jim Banks proposes a strategy to address what he calls a 'generational error' in the Supreme Court's recent decision on birthright citizenship.

item.title: Hillary Clinton urges unity with progressive wing
item.description: Hillary Clinton comments on El-Sayed, expressing hope that those who appear effective on screen can also deliver results, acknowledging the need for collaboration.

item.title: Darline Graham tests name recognition versus experience in South Carolina primary
item.description: Republican voters weigh an unexpected choice in the primary to replace Lindsey Graham, who was nominated for a fifth term, considering the value of a well-known name against a lack of political experience.

item.title: Hunter Biden says father's prostate cancer causes pain despite continued public engagement
item.description: Hunter Biden reports that former President Joe Biden's prostate cancer has spread and is causing pain, even as he remains active in public discourse.
